caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent glass pitcher with a bulbous body, a wide flared mouth, a prominent rounded base, and a single curved handle affixed to its side. The body of the pitcher is rendered in shades of light green and turquoise, with highlights and shading suggesting its glassy texture and transparency. There are swirling, ribbon-like decorative patterns within the body of the pitcher, executed in green hues. The rim and neck of the pitcher are adorned with evenly spaced, horizontal pinkish-red rings, creating a striped effect that contrasts with the greenish tone of the body. The handle is also green, with a slight tint variation indicating light and shadow, and curves from the upper lip to the upper side of the body, terminating with a small decorative loop. The background is plain and off-white with slight discoloration and faint spots. The artist's name, "Michael Trekur," is signed at the bottom right of the image in brown ink.
title: Pitcher
